stages.name: spec-lint
details: [LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[1].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable
[LINT-HY-007] hypotheses[5].description: Hypothesis appears to describe what will NOT be built; hypotheses must be affirmative and testable

master_key_env_only.statement: The password is read from VAULT_MASTER_KEY; the CLI has no password option, and a missing variable exits 2.

kdf_and_salt.statement: The file starts with a 16-byte random salt (different per vault), the rest decrypts as Fernet with a PBKDF2HMAC SHA-256 key of 200000 iterations, and contains no plaintext value.

key_validation.statement: Keys outside [a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64} exit 1; valid keys are stored lowercase so set Foo then get FOO works.

value_size_limit.statement: A value of 4096 UTF-8 bytes is accepted; 4097 bytes (counted in bytes, not characters) exits 1.

ttl_iso_default.statement: Without --ttl the stored expiry is now plus 90 days as ISO-8601; --ttl N uses N days; invalid TTL exits 1.

get_value_only.statement: get of a live key prints exactly the value and a newline to stdout, nothing else, exit 0; a missing key exits 1.

expired_exit_3.statement: get of an expired entry exits 3 and neither stdout nor stderr contains the value.

list_masks_values.statement: list prints each key with value[:4] followed by ***, never the full value, and expired entries show no value characters.

commands_roundtrip.statement: set, get, list, delete work end to end; delete of a missing key exits 1; rotate replaces the value and resets expiry.

rotate_missing_exit_1.statement: rotate of a nonexistent key exits 1 and does not create the key.

audit_tail.statement: Commands append to ~/.vault/audit.log; audit appends its own line and prints only the last 20 lines.

no_values_leak.statement: After set, get, rotate, failures and errors, no value appears in audit.log or stderr.
must_include: never write values to audit log or stderr

lockout_after_three.statement: Wrong passwords exit 2; the third creates ~/.vault/.lockout; afterwards even the correct password exits 2; a correct password before the third resets the counter.

file_modes.statement: vault.enc has mode 600 and ~/.vault/ has mode 700 after set, including when the directory pre-exists with looser permissions.

exit_code_map.statement: Exit codes are 0 for success, 1 for user errors, 2 for auth or lockout, 3 for expired.
